sql: SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, SUM("Bookings"."amount_of_refund") AS m1, AVG(("Bookings"."amount_of_discount" - "Bookings"."amount_payable")) AS m2, (SUM("Bookings"."amount_of_refund") - AVG(("Bookings"."amount_of_discount" - "Bookings"."amount_payable"))) AS m3 FROM "Bookings" GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Bookings.discount applied to booking minus amount payable for booking
why: total of refund amount for booking per Customers (by customer_id) (additive)
discount applied to booking - amount payable for booking: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one booking
average of discount applied to booking minus amount payable for booking per Customers (by customer_id)
total of refund amount for booking minus average of discount applied to booking minus amount payable for booking: both in USD, of the same kind, from different quantities

sql: SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, "Customers"."gender_mf" AS g, AVG("Bookings"."amount_of_discount") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Bookings"."amount_of_refund" - "Bookings"."amount_payable") AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_payable")) AS m2 FROM "Bookings" JOIN "Customers" ON "Customers"."customer_id" = "Bookings"."customer_id"  GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id", "Customers"."gender_mf" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Bookings.relative difference of refund amount for booking from amount payable for booking
why: average of discount applied to booking per Customers within Customers.gender_mf
(refund amount for booking - amount payable for booking) / amount payable for booking: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of refund amount for booking from amount payable for booking per Customers within Customers.gender_mf

sql: SELECT "Bookings"."customer_id" AS e, AVG((CAST(("Bookings"."amount_of_refund" - "Bookings"."amount_of_discount") AS REAL) / "Bookings"."amount_of_discount")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Bookings" GROUP BY "Bookings"."customer_id" ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
